fullText:
Ministry of Communications

Telecom Regulatory Authority of India releases findings of Independent Drive Test conducted across city route of Una, Mandi, Joginder Nagar and highway route of Una to Mandi and Mandi to Una under HP LSA, during the month of September 2026

26 NOV 2026 12:26PM by PIB Delhi

The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has released findings of Independent Drive Test (IDT) conducted across city route of Una, Mandi, Joginder Nagar and highway route of Una to Mandi and Mandi to Una under HP LSA, during the month of Sep 2026, for information of general telecom consumers. The purpose of this drive test is to assess and verify real time quality of mobile network services (both voice & data) provided by Telecom Service Providers (TSPs). During the IDT, TRAI captures performance of TSPs for key Quality of Service (QoS) parameters like Coverage, Call Drop Rate (CDR), Call Setup Success Rate (CSSR), data Download (DL) and Upload (UL) throughput etc., which are then published to inform Consumers and encourage TSPs to improve their services.

These IDTs have been designed to capture on ground mobile network performance of all TSPs across diverse usages environment like cities, hotspots, public transport hubs, etc. In this type of drive testing, live data and voice sessions are established using SIM cards from all TSPs over 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G networks. Multiple advanced test handsets are used, and the sessions are monitored and analyzed in real-time using advanced Software Systems.

TRAI, through its appointed agency, conducted drive tests across City drive – 373 Km, Hotspot locations - 06, Walk Test - 5.2 Km, Highway Drive – 225.1 Km, and Inter Operator Calling at 01 location during 15th Sep 2026 to 18th Sep 2026 in HP LSA. These tests were conducted under the supervision of the TRAI Regional Office Delhi. The observations presented in drive test reports represent the performance of the TSPs on the area / route under test on the day / time of conducting the drive test.

Drive test routes: The map provides overview of drive test routes indicating city drive, Inter-operator call test, hotspots, walk test and highway as per the legends shown on the map: -

Figure-1: Drive test routes

Key Parameters Assessed

(a) Coverage Gap: Percentage of samples, for which signal strength observed less than the minimum prescribed signal strength for respective technology (2G/ 3G/ 4G/ 5G).

(b) Voice Services: Call Setup Success Rate (CSSR), Drop Call Rate (DCR), Call Setup Time, Call Silence Rate, Speech Quality (MOS).

(c) Call Silence Instance: Number of call silence instances occurred during the calls.

(d) Data Services: Download / Upload Throughput, Latency, Jitter, Packet Drop Rate.

The overall mobile network performance across Una, Mandi & Joginder Nagar city (Himachal Pradesh LSA) for the key Parameters have been summarized below: -

Coverage Gap - The signal strength observed during voice testing on the drive test route in auto-selection mode (5G/4G/3G/2G), measured as the number of samples having poor signal strength out of the total samples collected, was 3846/64200 for Airtel, 20158/60813 for BSNL, 2174/63875 for RJIL and 16902/63375 for VIL. Details of the coverage gaps have been provided in the map of Annexure-I.

Dropped Calls - Dropped calls in auto-selection mode (5G/ 4G/ 3G/ 2G), measured as the number of dropped calls out of the number of successfully established calls, were 5/570 for Airtel, 49/538 for BSNL, 3/565 for RJIL and 13/560 for VIL. Details of the dropped call locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-I.

Call Silence Instance - Call silence instances in Auto-selection mode (5G/4G), measured as the total number of silence instances observed for > 3 seconds out of the total calls established, were 15/536 for Airtel, 4/433 for BSNL, 9/539 for RJIL and 12/497 for VIL. Details of the call silence instance locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-I.

Data Download and Upload Throughput:

Data Download performance (Overall): Average download speed was observed as 122.28 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 9.49 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 171.68 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 12.18 Mbps for VIL (4G). Detail of Download throughput has been provided in the map of Annexure-I.

Data Upload performance (Overall): Average upload speed was observed as 13.44 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 4.57 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 18.01 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 5.45 Mbps for VIL (4G). Details of Upload throughput have been provided in the map of Annexure-I.

Locations of Dropped Calls and Call Silence instances can be seen by clicking red dot on the map of Annexure-I.

The overall mobile network performance on Una to Mandi highway route (Himachal Pradesh LSA) for the key Parameters has been summarized below: -

Coverage Gap - The signal strength observed during voice testing on the drive test route in auto-selection mode (5G/4G/3G/2G), measured as the number of samples having poor signal strength out of the total samples collected, was 387/13127 for Airtel, 3173/12473 for BSNL, 344/12972 for RJIL and 3206/12923 for VIL. Details of the coverage gaps have been provided in the map of Annexure-II.

Dropped Calls - Dropped calls in auto-selection mode (5G/ 4G/ 3G/ 2G), measured as the number of dropped calls out of the number of successfully established calls, were 2/67 for Airtel, 7/63 for BSNL, 2/65 for RJIL and 6/65 for VIL. Details of the dropped call locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-II.

Call Silence Instance - Call silence instances in Auto-selection mode (5G/4G), measured as the total number of silence instances observed for > 3 seconds out of the total calls established, were 1/66 for Airtel, 2/61 for BSNL, 4/65 for RJIL and 2/64 for VIL. Details of the call silence instance locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-II.

i) Data Download performance (Overall): Average download speed was observed as 169.31 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 9.32 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 193.46 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 10.36 Mbps for VIL (4G). Detail of Download throughput has been provided in the map of Annexure-II.

ii) Data Upload performance (Overall): Average upload speed was observed as 15.54 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 6.29 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 21.43 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 5.30 Mbps for VIL (4G). Details of Upload throughput have been provided in the map of Annexure-II.

Locations of Dropped Calls and Call Silence instances can be seen by clicking red dot on the map of Annexure-II.

The overall mobile network performance on Mandi to Una highway route (Himachal Pradesh LSA) for the key Parameters has been summarized below: -

Coverage Gap - The signal strength observed during voice testing on the drive test route in auto-selection mode (5G/4G/3G/2G), measured as the number of samples having poor signal strength out of the total samples collected, was 396/12455 for Airtel, 3403/12632 for BSNL, 334/11892 for RJIL and 2466/12200 for VIL. Details of the coverage gaps have been provided in the map of Annexure-III.

Dropped Calls - Dropped calls in auto-selection mode (5G/ 4G/ 3G/ 2G), measured as the number of dropped calls out of the number of successfully established calls, were 1/62 for Airtel, 13/67 for BSNL, 2/61 for RJIL and 3/61 for VIL. Details of the dropped call locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-III.

Call Silence Instance - Call silence instances in Auto-selection mode (5G/4G), measured as the total number of silence instances observed for > 3 seconds out of the total calls established, were 1/60 for Airtel, 1/58 for BSNL, 2/60 for RJIL and 0/61 for VIL. Details of the call silence instance locations have been provided in the map of Annexure-III.

i) Data Download performance (Overall): Average download speed was observed as 209.58 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 10.15 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 194.88 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 9.63 Mbps for VIL (4G). Detail of Download throughput has been provided in the map of Annexure-III.

ii) Data Upload performance (Overall): Average upload speed was observed as 14.67 Mbps for Airtel (5G), 5.59 Mbps for BSNL (4G), 14.40 Mbps for RJIL (5G) and 4.36 Mbps for VIL (4G). Details of Upload throughput have been provided in the map of Annexure-III.

Locations of Dropped Calls and Call Silence instances can be seen by clicking red dot on the map of Annexure-III.

Details of drive test route and area covered during the IDT are as below: -

City - The areas covered in the city drive are Una, Lal Singhi, Jhelara, Jal Gran, Dangoli, Bhadwar, Barnoh, Matyana, Shiv Nagar, Takoli, Bharmar, Chauki Maniar, Baruhi, Akrot, Kutheram, Amb, Mandi, Randhara, Rewalsar, Dhalwan, Kapahi, Sundar Nagar, Dadour, Gutkar, Mehar, Kunnu, Narla, Padhar, Kotropi, Urla, Ghatasani, Harabhag, Joginder Nagar, Chauntra, Machial, Baroti, Giun, Kotli etc. and nearby areas.

Highway - The area covered in the Highway route are Una to Mandi via Gutkar, Ner Chowk, Sundar Nagar, Bilaspur, Kothipura, Kiratpur Sahib, Anandpur Sahib, Nangal and Mehatpur etc. and Mandi to Una via Ner Chowk, Jahu, Ladrpur, Bhota, Salouni, Barsar and Bangana etc.

Hotspot - The hotspot locations, capturing stationary user experience are Lal Bahadur Shastri Government Hospital Mandi, Mandi Bus Stand, Mandi Mall Road Purani Mandi-Mandi, Regional Hospital Una & Una Bus Stand.

Walk Test - The walk test conducted on 17th Sep 2026 & 18th Sep 2026, covered Jivan Market Una & Mandi Mall Road capturing mobile network behaviours in crowded pedestrian environments.

The findings of this IDT report have been shared with respective TSPs for taking further necessary action at their end. Detailed reports of IDT are made available on the TRAI website at www.trai.gov.in. For any clarification or additional information, an email can be sent to adv.delhi@trai.gov or Regional Office of TRAI at Delhi RO can be contacted on telephone No. +91-11-20907772.

summaryText:
### OVERVIEW
The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) released findings from an Independent Drive Test (IDT) conducted from September 15–18, 2026, across city routes in Una, Mandi, and Joginder Nagar and highway routes between Una and Mandi within the Himachal Pradesh Licensed Service Area (LSA) to assess real-time mobile network quality of service for Airtel, BSNL, RJIL, and VIL across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G technologies.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- **Test Scope & Methodology:** Drive tests covered 373 km of city routes, 225.1 km of highway routes, 6 hotspot locations, 5.2 km of walk tests, and inter-operator calling at 1 location; live voice and data sessions were tested using SIMs from all TSPs on 2G/3G/4G/5G networks under TRAI Regional Office Delhi supervision.
- **Release Date:** Findings published on November 26, 2026, via PIB Delhi for consumer information and TSP service improvement.
- **City Route Performance (Una, Mandi, Joginder Nagar):**
  - **Coverage Gap (Poor Signal Samples/Total Samples):** Airtel 3,846/64,200; BSNL 20,158/60,813; RJIL 2,174/63,875; VIL 16,902/63,375.
  - **Dropped Calls (Dropped/Established):** Airtel 5/570; BSNL 49/538; RJIL 3/565; VIL 13/560.
  - **Call Silence Instances (>3 seconds, Instances/Established Calls):** Airtel 15/536; BSNL 4/433; RJIL 9/539; VIL 12/497.
  - **Average Data Download Throughput:** Airtel 122.28 Mbps (5G); BSNL 9.49 Mbps (4G); RJIL 171.68 Mbps (5G); VIL 12.18 Mbps (4G).
  - **Average Data Upload Throughput:** Airtel 13.44 Mbps (5G); BSNL 4.57 Mbps (4G); RJIL 18.01 Mbps (5G); VIL 5.45 Mbps (4G).
- **Highway Route Performance (Una to Mandi):**
  - **Coverage Gap (Poor Signal Samples/Total Samples):** Airtel 387/13,127; BSNL 3,173/12,473; RJIL 344/12,972; VIL 3,206/12,923.
  - **Dropped Calls (Dropped/Established):** Airtel 2/67; BSNL 7/63; RJIL 2/65; VIL 6/65.
  - **Call Silence Instances (>3 seconds, Instances/Established Calls):** Airtel 1/66; BSNL 2/61; RJIL 4/65; VIL 2/64.
  - **Average Data Download Throughput:** Airtel 169.31 Mbps (5G); BSNL 9.32 Mbps (4G); RJIL 193.46 Mbps (5G); VIL 10.36 Mbps (4G).
  - **Average Data Upload Throughput:** Airtel 15.54 Mbps (5G); BSNL 6.29 Mbps (4G); RJIL 21.43 Mbps (5G); VIL (4G) data cut off in source text.
- **Reporting:** Detailed coverage gap, dropped call, call silence, and throughput maps provided in Annexure-I (City) and Annexure-II (Highway).
